body:
Problems with cloning using XStream serialisation/deserialisation is also the cause of the issues https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/9677 and https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/9884

There is quite a list of limitations in the XStream-FAQ, e.g. [My lambda expression is serialized to null!](https://x-stream.github.io/faq.html#Serialization_lambda_null)
Yeah, we'll have to address that

issue.body:
Fixes: #9886

This obviously only fixes the specific case for `Supplier`, but I would like to try and stick to the XStream method (since it's so simple) unless we run into problems that will truly require something custom

issue.title: DeepClone in QuarkusTestExtension returns null

labels.name: upstream/closed
labels.description: The issue has been closed in the upstream repository

issue.body:
Custom JUnit5 extensions providing non-primitive test method arguments have issues wrt TCCL.
This is "solved" with DeepClone workaround.
But in our case this DeepClone impl returns null for a simple JDK Supplier instance:
* https://quarkusio.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187030-users/topic/deep.20clone
